nom: Lancôme Galatée Confort Comforting Milky Creme Cleanser

segments.dry: Many dry-skin reviewers report the cleanser removes makeup and cleans without leaving a tight or dried-out feeling, though one reviewer with dry skin says it dried her skin out further and left residue.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some with rosacea, describe it as gentle, non-irritating and soothing with no burning, but other reviewers not self-describing as sensitive report burning and eye irritation lasting up to two days.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report it deeply cleans while still leaving skin hydrated and not stripped.
segments.oily: One reviewer with combination/oily skin says it leaves a slight oily film that absorbs in and reports improved overall oiliness and smaller-looking pores after weeks of use.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers, including one self-identified skincare specialist, say it addresses aging-skin concerns and leaves skin looking youthful and soft.
segments.normal: One reviewer simply calls it great for smooth skin without specifying further concerns.

concerns.aging: Reviewers describing themselves as having mature or aging skin report the product looks after older-skin concerns and leaves skin looking youthful and smooth; one reviewer states her skin looks more youthful from using it.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report it moisturizes and hydrates without a tight or dry after-feel, but one reviewer says it dried her skin out and another found it left a filmy, unclean feeling.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or reactive skin report it calms redness-prone skin without stripping moisture.
concerns.barrier: Sensitive and reactive-skin reviewers report no irritation or itching and describe it as soothing, while a smaller number report burning or eye irritation lasting up to two days.
concerns.spots: One reviewer says the product gave her more pimples and caused worry, while another explicitly states it does not break out her face; opinions are mixed.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the product broke her out in acne; most other reviewers do not mention breakouts, and several note clear, soft skin afterward.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with combination/oily skin reports a slight oily residue right after use that later seemed to reduce overall oiliness and pore size; another separate reviewer reports the product leaves skin feeling oily and needs rinsing with warm water afterward.

extraits.texte: Okay, I see this face wash has a couple good reviews, but for me it just does not work. I've had it for a while, never been impressed. It doesn't effectively take off make up...I've washed my face 3 times and still have traces of makeup. It also dries my skin out, which isn't good when it's for dry skin and also not cheap. I'm honestly getting better feeling, CLEAN skin with much cheaper products.

extraits.titre: OBSESSED- amazing for my dry and sensitive skin
extraits.texte: LOVE!!! I typically use this at night to take off my makeup. It literally MELTS the makeup away. I apply 1-2 pumps then rinse or wipe away with warm cloth or disposable wipe. It removes makeup and cleans without drying your skin. It smells WONDERFUL and I look forward to taking off my makeup. My skin is dry-sensitive and occasionally combination so I am thoroughly impressed that this smells so lovely and soothes the skin with no irritation. My husband compliments me that I smell nice when I climb into bed after nightly skincare routine. My skin feels GREAT and no tight or dry feeling I often get with other cleansers. It is moisturizing but does not leave you greasy. The packaging is lovely as well. My NEW fave for aging, dry, and even sensitive skin!! It truly is comforting!!

I wasn't quite sure what to expect, but this actually does a GREAT job removing my foundation, leaves my skin feeling really soft. There is a slightly oily feel after using which actually seems to absorb in and has improved my over all oiliness in the last few weeks. And it smells lovely to me, slightly almond and slightly baby powder. And my pores look so much smaller which is a big deal for me.

I have rosacea and need something mild. This cleanser is perfect! It's creamy, soft and effective but doesn't strip your skin of moisture. It even breaks down mascara! It has a clean, light fragrance. I highly recommend!

Sensitive/Combination Skin Acne and blackheads I've been searching for years to find the perfect cleanser. One that hydrates but still deeply cleans my skin. I finally found it. When washing this cleanser off my face, I felt how soft and hydrated it was while it was still feeling squeaky clean. If you are looking for a cleanser that doesn't leave your skin feeling super dry, this is it! I 100% recommend this product.

This is one of the best cleansers and makeup removes I've found. I usually use the Lancome comfort face wash with the pink lettering(can't remember the name), but decided to switch to this since it's much larger(though the small one of the other normally lasts me almost a year). My skin is prone to dryness,flaking,and irritation, especially as the colder months roll around. I use this at night as a makeup remover and cleanser and ot noticeably shrinks my pores and makes my skin silky smooth,soft,and hydrated. I of course still use toner and moisturizer afterwards, but I no longer need to wear a daily moisturizing mask or heavy cream to bed. I wake up still with smooth, clean and clear looking skin. I have sensitive skin and this is non-irritating; it's actually soothing. In the AM I use Hada Labo Gokujyun cream cleanser which feels very nice, but I love this so much that I'm considering fully switching over for winter. Definitely recommend for dry,sensitive,flaky,cold- irritated, or mature skin. It has a scent(almondy), but it isn't very strong. Cleans well without stripping oils, feels like lotion, great gentle makeup remover and cleanser.
